fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说说我在意的东西。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to talk about things I care about.
I think everyone is different.

fullTextZH: 可能有的人在意他的脸，对。
fullTextEN: Maybe some people care about their face, right.
Some people have pimples.
So he cares a lot.
Some people care about their height.
Maybe he is very short.
Maybe he is very tall.
Some people care about their figure.
Maybe he is very fat.
Maybe he is very thin.
What about you, what do you care about?
Face? Height?
Figure?
Or something else?

fullTextZH: 对我觉得每个人不一样。
fullTextEN: Right, I think everyone is different.
Every phase is also different.

fullTextZH: 我小时候，我不喜欢朋友来我家。
fullTextEN: When I was young, I didn't like friends coming to my house.
Why do you think that is?
I didn't like friends coming to my house.
Is it because my house is very small?

fullTextZH: 不，不是因为我的房子很小。
fullTextEN: No, it's not because my house is very small.
Is it because my house is very shabby?

fullTextZH: 不，不是因为我的房子很破。
fullTextEN: No, it's not because my house is very shabby.
Then why?

fullTextZH: 因为一个很小很小的东西。
fullTextEN: Because of a very, very small thing.
My home is in Fujian, China, right.
Fujian, what does Fujian have?
Fujian has a lot of tea.

fullTextZH: 所以福建人喜欢喝茶，对。
fullTextEN: So people in Fujian like to drink tea, right.
If you come to my house,
I will make tea for you to drink.
But there is a problem.
The teapot at my house
is very, very big,
extremely, extremely big,
very ugly, very old.
So I don't like it.
I care a lot.

fullTextZH: 如果我的朋友看到我的茶壶，
fullTextEN: If my friends see my teapot,
Maybe they think
Very ugly, very old teapot.

fullTextZH: 所以我不喜欢我的朋友来我家。
fullTextEN: So I don't like my friends coming to my house.

fullTextZH: 因为我不喜欢我家的茶壶。
fullTextEN: Because I don't like my home's teapot.

fullTextZH: 可是我的爸爸妈妈，他们不在意。
fullTextEN: But my parents, they don't mind.
They think it doesn't matter.

fullTextZH: 所以我家一直用这个很老、
fullTextEN: So my family always uses this very old,
very ugly, very large teapot.
So I always care a lot.
Always feel very embarrassed.
I don't like this teapot.

fullTextZH: 这是第一个我很在意很在意的东西。
fullTextEN: This is the first thing I really, really care about.
When I was in middle school,

fullTextZH: 我在意的是我的爸爸妈妈。
fullTextEN: What I cared about was my parents.

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得我的爸爸妈妈看起来很老。
fullTextEN: Because I thought my parents looked very old.
Their jobs were also not good,
because they were farmers.

fullTextZH: 所以我不喜欢我的爸爸妈妈来我的学校。
fullTextEN: So I didn't like my parents coming to my school.
I thought everyone would know,
my parents were farmers.
They look very old,
They look like they have no money.

fullTextZH: 所以那个时候，我觉得有一点点丢脸。
fullTextEN: So at that time, I felt a little embarrassed.

fullTextZH: 我不喜欢别人看到我的爸爸、我的妈妈。
fullTextEN: I didn't like others seeing my dad and my mom.
Yes, the second one

fullTextZH: 我在意的是我的爸爸和我的妈妈。
fullTextEN: What I care about is my dad and my mom.

fullTextZH: 慢慢地，我在意我的身高，对。
fullTextEN: Gradually, I cared about my height, yes.
I think I'm very short.
I think, if I'm very short,
then my children will also be very short.
What to do?

fullTextZH: 对，所以我很在意我的身高。
fullTextEN: Yes, so I care a lot about my height.

fullTextZH: 如果一个人问我，你多高？
fullTextEN: If someone asks me, how tall are you?
I don't like to talk about my height.
Because I think I'm very short,
so I care a lot.

fullTextZH: 我记得我的第一个男朋友，
fullTextEN: I remember my first boyfriend,

fullTextZH: 他很高，他差不多一米8多。
fullTextEN: He was very tall, he was almost over 1.8 meters.

fullTextZH: 我很矮，所以我不喜欢和他站在一起。
fullTextEN: I'm very short, so I didn't like standing next to him.

fullTextZH: 我觉得如果我和他站在一起，
fullTextEN: I think if I stand next to him,
It might look strange, right?

fullTextZH: 所以我不喜欢和他站在一起。
fullTextEN: So I don't like standing with him.
Right, so the third one

fullTextZH: 我很在意的东西是我的身高。
fullTextEN: What I care about is my height.
Because I think I'm very short.
Then slowly,
I care about my age.
At 25 years old, I started working.
Then I thought I was already 25,
I should think,
I want to get married,
I want to have children,
I want to buy a house.

fullTextZH: 可是我25岁的时候，我什么都没有。
fullTextEN: But when I was 25, I had nothing.
Of course, I couldn't get married,
Couldn't have children,
Couldn't buy a house.
Couldn't do any of it.
I think I'm too old,
I have nothing.

fullTextZH: 所以如果一个人问我，你多大？
fullTextEN: So if someone asks me, how old are you?
I don't like to say my age.
I will say, you guess.
Right,

fullTextZH: 所以我25岁的时候，我很在意我的年龄。
fullTextEN: So when I was 25, I cared a lot about my age.
When I was 27, I came to Australia.

fullTextZH: 慢慢地，我不在意很多很多东西。
fullTextEN: Gradually, I stopped caring about many things.
I don't care about my height,
Because in Australia,
No one says,
Oh, you are too short,
Your child will also be very short.
In Australia,
Many people say, um,
You are short, so you are cute, right.

fullTextZH: 所以慢慢地，我不在意我的身高。
fullTextEN: So gradually, I don't care about my height.

fullTextZH: 我也不在意我的爸爸和我的妈妈，
fullTextEN: I also don't care about my dad and my mom,
Because I know,
Being a farmer

fullTextZH: 在中国不是一个好的工作，
fullTextEN: is not a good job in China,
But it's not embarrassing.
Because they have no choice.

fullTextZH: 现在我也不在意我的年龄，
fullTextEN: Now I also don't care about my age,

fullTextZH: 因为我决定我不要结婚，
fullTextEN: Because I decided I don't want to get married,
I don't want to have children.
So I feel I'm not in a hurry,
I can take my time.

fullTextZH: 所以现在我真的不在意我的年龄。
fullTextEN: So now I really don't care about my age.
I often forget my age.

fullTextZH: 我一直记得我有一个朋友，
fullTextEN: I always remember I have a friend,

fullTextZH: 她非常非常在意她的雀斑(freckle)，对。
fullTextEN: She is very, very concerned about her freckles, right.

fullTextZH: 她的脸上有一点点雀斑，嗯，
fullTextEN: She has a few freckles on her face, um,
She thinks they don't look good.

fullTextZH: 她觉得可能她的孩子也会有雀斑。
fullTextEN: She thinks maybe her children will also have freckles.
She cares a lot.

fullTextZH: 可是如果她来澳大利亚，
fullTextEN: But if she comes to Australia,
Maybe many, many people will say,
Your freckles are cute.
What about you, what do you care about?
Leave a comment and tell me.
Thank you, see you next time, bye.
